name: Hunter Romanillos
bio: Hunter Romanillos is a Filipino-American actor best known for his recurring role as Chance in the Netflix series Stranger Things. Since then, he has worked alongside Vince Vaughn on the Apple TV+ novel adaptation Bad Monkey, as well as the ABC series Will Trent and high-school family comedy film Popular Theory.

credits.title: Fresh Meat
credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: SHED
credits.overview: Becca Novak, a successful but isolated young woman stalked by grief, is haunted inside her own body – until a final, brutal revelation shatters everything she thought she knew about herself.

credits.title: The Witchening
credits.overview: A babysitter dismisses a child's bedtime story about a vengeful witch, but soon learns it's all true...

credits.title: Sleigh
credits.overview: On the 50th anniversary of his horrific death, a shopping mall Santa Claus returns to seek revenge on all those connected to the tragedy.

credits.title: Soft Side
credits.overview: Angry and brooding school drop-out, Hunter Hall, spends his nights driving and picking fights when an estranged family member suddenly causes him to question his lifestyle.

credits.title: Twin Flame
credits.overview: When tragedy occurs, young Thomas is tasked with delivering punishment, aided by a connection which blurs the line between the living and dead.

credits.title: My Fatal Social Following
credits.overview: Julia, a lonely and ostracized teenager, is coming to terms with the disappearance of her best friend when she discovers a mysterious social media account called 'The Family'.

credits.title: Popular Theory
credits.overview: Erwin, a girl genius, is the youngest student in high school. Unfortunately she struggles with social isolation. When she meets fellow science guru, Winston, they team up to invent a chemical that changes the high school hierarchy forever.

credits.title: My Killer Reunion
credits.overview: When Claire and her husband James attend a medical school reunion, they reconnect with an old classmate named Morgan, who is secretly obsessed with James and plans to sabotage Claire’s life so she can have him all to herself.

credits.title: Smashing Pumpkins
credits.overview: When a baseball team’s hazing ritual goes wrong, they accidentally send an evil figure on a blood path after an innocent victim of their choosing.

credits.title: Illuminated
credits.overview: Jasper and Selena have been together for 6 months but something is preventing them from having sex. Jasper feels uneasy with the idea of intimacy. He seeks help to find out why and when he is introduced to Crystal by a mutual friend, she helps him come to terms with the possibility that he may be asexual.
